vul.name: Clementine Vulgate (Latin)
vul.attribution: Clementine Vulgate text transcribed by Michael Tweedale (vulsearch), via the Open Bibles collection (seven1m/open-bibles, lat-clementine.usfx.xml). The original text is public domain; users are requested to acknowledge the source and make clear any modifications. Verses were placed next to the WEB by automatic alignment with the public-domain Douay-Rheims (eng-dra.usfx.xml). The Vulgate reference is always stored. Modification: words are unaltered; verse grouping follows the WEB.
